title: Keeping Up with the Language Models: Systematic Benchmark Extension for Bias Auditing

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring pro- and anti-stereotype mispredictions in Natural Language Inference (NLI) tasks using premise-hypothesis pairs about gender roles, and employing counterfactual group swapping to separate bias from model brittleness.

Evaluating Natural Language Inference (NLI) models on premise-hypothesis pairs involving racial stereotypes, detecting bias through mispredicted entailment or contradiction labels and isolating it via counterfactual group substitution.
Testing NLI models for biased mispredictions on premise-hypothesis pairs targeting religious identities, utilizing counterfactual hypothesis pairs to distinguish true bias from general model error.
